# abcd-banlist: keyed
# abcd-banlist-example
# Fixture banlist — a KEYED store: line 1 above declares the format, so every
# non-comment line below MUST parse as KEY<space-or-tab>PATTERN. Read by BOTH
# readers of that format — the Go parser (private_test.go) and the committed
# .githooks/pre-commit hook (hook_test.go). Every value is reserved for
# documentation (RFC 5737/3849/2606/7042) or derived from the persona registry;
# nothing here names a real machine, network, or organisation.
#
# Patterns are POSIX extended regular expressions, matched case-insensitively by
# the enforcing grep.
#
# Line 2 is the published per-file escape: this file is a committed FIXTURE whose
# first line declares the store format, so without it the guard would refuse to
# commit the corpus that proves the guard works. It exempts this blob from the
# copy refusals only — its content is still scanned against every entry.

lab-mac          00:00:5E:00:53:1A
